title: maint.event.v1{kind=restore}
description: Phase 8 §8.1 / §8.3 — operator-driven restore from a stored backup. ALWAYS_DESTRUCTIVE: replaces live data. `target` is the dump date (YYYY-MM-DD); `from_offsite` selects the off-host replica when true (per §8.12). Consumer: maint.backup.v1 (lands in §8.3).

from_offsite.description: When true, pull the dump from the off-host replica (§8.12) instead of the on-host PVC. Default false.

destination_conn.description: Optional override DSN. When unset, the consumer (maint.backup.v1) restores into an ephemeral target named `negelir_restore_<dump_date>` (per §8.3 binding) which the operator then promotes manually. When set AND it resolves to the live application Postgres, the consumer also requires `confirm_overwrite_live=true`.

confirm_overwrite_live.description: Operator opt-in to overwrite the live primary (i.e. `destination_conn` resolves to the live app DSN). Without this flag the consumer refuses with reason `live_overwrite_requires_confirm`. Default false.

reason.description: Operator narration for the audit trail.
